comment: detect.c openone() secret-corridor and unseen-trap arms (1766-1769, 1775-1777). A debug Valkyrie teleports into the corridor east of her starting room, wishes a secret corridor under herself, steps south and wishes an (unseen) sleeping gas trap there, steps back north between the two, then wishes for a blessed Bell of Opening and rings it: apply.c use_bell() -> openit() -> do_clear_area(openone) turns the secret corridor into corridor and marks the trap seen. Seed, date, role and trap type were chosen independently of the existing openone-blessed-bell recordings, which already run these lines.
